As the last part of this quest chain, deliver a [[Letter from Ambassador Zain|letter]] and find the outpost for the [[Gates of Kryta]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
* [[Gates of Kryta]] mission not complete
* ''Note:'' This quest is available to all nationalities, not just {{Tyria}} [[Tyrian]] ([[Prophecies]]) characters

===Objectives===
* Deliver the [[Letter from Ambassador Zain|letter]] to [[Ambassador Braun]].
* See [[Witness Casori]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
After accepting the quest from Aidan, proceed through the portal to [[Scoundrel's Rise]]. Deliver Aidan's letter to [[Ambassador Braun]], who will be waiting for you right outside, and he will direct you to the [[Gates of Kryta (outpost)|Gates of Kryta]].

Several [[undead]] creatures will be scattered throughout Scoundrel's Rise, replacing many of its usual [[Gargoyle|Mergoyle]] and [[Skale]] spawns. Stick to the southeastern side of the map as you head for the Gates of Kryta outpost, and you will only have to deal with single [[Zombie Warlock]]s and hidden groups of [[Grasping Ghoul]]s, which should pose little threat to a party capable of fighting through [[Griffon's Mouth]]. Advance cautiously, since the ghouls often try to surprise you while you are engaging a different foe, and their [[Crippling Attack]] makes it difficult to retreat. Prioritize killing the Warlocks to prevent them from casting [[Death Nova]] and to avoid providing them with ghoul corpses to raise as [[minion]]s. [[Illusion of Haste]] is a useful skill for mesmers trying to disengage from the ghouls, and other forms of condition removal are worth bringing.

Alternatively, you can enter Scoundrel's Rise, deliver the letter to Ambassador Braun, and immediately use the Griffon's Mouth portal to re-zone, eliminating the quest spawns from Scoundrel's Rise. This will mean that most of the enemies between you and the Gates of Kryta outpost will be groups of [[Mergoyle Wavebreaker]]s, so be prepared to deal with [[Deep Freeze]]. This version of Scoundrel's Rise has no hidden foes.

When you reach the Gates of Kryta, talk to [[Witness Casori]] to claim the reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial Dialogue===
;Aidan
:''"I have a letter here for Ambassador Zain informing him of Prince Rurik's death. You can give it to [[Ambassador Braun]] when you see him. Zain has assigned him to the refugee problem, so he'll work out the details involved in getting them settled. Meet Braun in [[Scoundrel's Rise]], just outside the gate to [[Griffon's Mouth]]."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'm on my way.
| decline = Perhaps another time.
| ask = Take Ambassador Zain's letter to [[Ambassador Braun]]. He alone can provide for these refugees.
}}

===Intermediate Dialogue===
;Ambassador Braun
:''"The undead have risen from the swamps. The gates to Lion's Arch have been closed. Times are bad indeed."''

:''"I have been appointed by Ambassador Zain to handle the matter of seeing your people settled. The ambassador will be saddened to hear of your great prince, I am sure."''

:''"Here is the letter from Ambassador Zain granting refuge in Kryta. Present it to [[Witness Casori]], the city's regent. Perhaps she can help you."''

===Reward Dialogue===
;Witness Casori
:''"Yes, Braun told us to expect you. I understand you have Ambassador Zain's decree allowing your people to settle here. I'm afraid, however, that powers above me are ordering my [[Gates of Kryta|city's gates closed]] even to Krytans."''

:''"You've done these people a great service."''

==Notes==
*Even though Ambassador Braun's dialogue suggests that he takes the letter and hands it back again, the item is not returned to your inventory. Simply talk to [[Witness Casori]] to complete the quest.

{{anomaly|Completing the preceding quest, [[To Kryta: The Ice Cave]], is not required to take this quest, even for native characters.}}
{{anomaly|Unlike other [[Northern Shiverpeaks]] quests, this quest is available to characters from other campaigns, despite chronologically coming before the Ascalonians' arrival in [[Lion's Arch]].}}
{{anomaly|Despite Braun's claims to hate the undead, he will heal any injured undead that come near him.}}
